body:
# Aspose.Cells FOSS for Go v26.11.0

**Release date:** 2026-11-12

A major feature release: the formula engine grows from 4 to 22 functions with cross-sheet
references and Excel error values, rows can be inserted and deleted with full feature
shifting, workbooks can be read and written over arbitrary streams, encrypted files now
open directly in Microsoft Excel — and 12 critical round-trip fidelity defects are fixed.

## ✨ Highlights

- **Formula engine expansion** — 22 functions (`SUM`, `AVERAGE`, `MAX`, `MIN`, `COUNT`,
  `COUNTIF`, `VLOOKUP`, `IF`, `AND`, `OR`, `NOT`, `ROUND`, `ABS`, `POWER`, `SQRT`, `CONCAT`,
  `LEN`, `LEFT`, `RIGHT`, `MID`, `UPPER`, `LOWER`), arithmetic (`+ - * / ^ &`), comparisons,
  unary minus, nested calls with literal arguments, cross-sheet references (`Sheet2!A1`,
  `'My Sheet'!B2:C3`), and the new `ErrorValue` type — the seven Excel error constants
  (`#DIV/0!`, `#N/A`, …) propagate through evaluation the way Excel does.
- **Row insert/delete** — `Worksheet.InsertRow` / `DeleteRow` shift cells, row heights,
  merged ranges, hyperlinks, auto-filters, validation / conditional-formatting / table /
  pivot ranges, chart data ranges, and picture and chart anchors, following Excel's
  expand/shrink/drop semantics. Formula text is not rewritten (documented limitation).
- **Stream I/O** — `Workbook.SaveTo(io.Writer)`, `LoadFrom(io.Reader)`, and
  `LoadFromWithPassword(io.Reader, password)` read and write the same packages over HTTP
  responses, zip entries, or network streams without touching the filesystem.
- **Excel-compatible encryption** — `Workbook.SetPassword` output is rewritten to a standard
  OLE/CFB container with ECMA-376 Agile Encryption per MS-OFFCRYPTO (SHA-512 key derivation,
  AES-256-CBC segmented payload, HMAC-SHA512 integrity). Generated files now open directly in
  Microsoft Excel; legacy `ECRX` files still load.
- **Number formats & date serials** — `Style.NumberFormat` with built-in and custom format
  codes, plus `TimeToSerial` / `SerialToTime` helpers (1900 date system).
- **Worksheet layout & hyperlinks** — merged cells, column widths, row heights, freeze panes,
  auto-filters, and external/internal cell hyperlinks, all round-tripping through save/load.
- **Conditional formatting** — `colorScale`, `dataBar`, `iconSet` (17 built-in sets), and
  `top10` rules join the existing cellIs/text/expression rules with DXF styles; ranges are
  written with the spec-compliant `sqref` attribute.
- **Charts** — scatter and area types join bar/line/pie; new axis titles/visibility and
  legend position/overlay models with spec-compliant chart XML.
- **Data validation operators** — `DataValidation.Operator` with the full OOXML
  `ST_DataValidationOperator` set (between, notBetween, equal, notEqual, lessThan,
  lessThanOrEqual, greaterThan, greaterThanOrEqual).
- **Named worksheets** — `Workbook.AddWorksheet(name)` with Excel's naming rules enforced.

## 🐛 Critical fixes

Twelve round-trip fidelity defects fixed, including:

- Shared-string indexes are preserved on re-save — no more corrupted strings or bloated
  `sharedStrings.xml`.
- `Cell.SetFormula` / `Cell.SetStyle` mark content dirty, so changes actually persist.
- Worksheet XML follows ECMA-376 element order (`f` before `v`) — fixes Excel repair prompts.
- Content types and relationships declare only the parts actually present; unmodified sheets
  are reused byte-for-byte, so untouched content round-trips identically.
- Globally unique chart/pivot/media part names in multi-sheet workbooks.
- `inlineStr` cells are read by both the workbook loader and the streaming reader.
- CSV: import infers numeric/boolean types like Excel; export uses a sparse-safe bounding
  box and writes UTF-8 BOM + CRLF line endings.
- Formula evaluation: quote-aware argument splitting, rune-safe string functions for
  non-ASCII text, out-of-range `MID` returns an error instead of panicking.
- Save-path XML generation failures return errors instead of panicking; previously ignored
  load errors are propagated.

## ⚠️ Deprecations

No new deprecations in this release. Previously deprecated APIs remain:

- `Cell.Value` → use `Cell.AsString` / `AsFloat64` / `AsInt`
- `Workbook.VerifyPassword` → use `Workbook.CheckPassword` (constant-time)
- `test_helpers.go` exports (test scaffolding, not supported API)

## 📚 Documentation & examples

- New **[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Go/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)**
  with the complete per-item change list.
- README and `docs/usage.md` updated for the full 26.11 feature set.
- 21 runnable examples under `examples/` — 10 new: `add_worksheet`, `chart`,
  `conditional_format`, `encryption`, `layout`, `macro`, `number_format`, `pivot_table`,
  `row_operations`, `stream_io`.

## 📦 Installation

```bash
go get github.com/aspose-cells-foss/Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Go/v26/aspose/cells_foss
```

Requires Go 1.24.5+. Zero third-party dependencies — standard library only.

Aspose.Cells-FOSS-for-Go v26.7.0 New Features:

Cells — A1-style references, read/write/remove cells, supports string, float64, int, bool
Styles — Font (bold/italic/size/color), fill, alignment, borders with automatic deduplication
Formulas — Write Excel formulas, built-in SUM / AVERAGE / MAX / MIN calculation engine
Data Validation — Dropdown lists, whole/decimal ranges, custom error messages and styles
Tables — Structured data regions with header rows and auto-filters
Pictures — PNG / JPEG embedding with anchor positioning
CSV Import/Export — Custom delimiters, automatic type conversion
Streaming Reader — Row-by-row processing, O(row-width) memory, handles 100K+ row files
Encryption — ECMA-376 Agile Encryption (SHA-512 + AES-256-CBC) with password protection
